title: ProductSummary
description: Renders a single commerce product as a compact summary row (thumbnail, name, short description, price) for a category slot. Read-only from the frontend: the backend is the sole source of truth for the summarized product. Presentation as a compact row is expressed by this component type on the A2-UI plane, never as data in AG-UI state.

ProductSummaryState.title: ProductSummaryState
ProductSummaryState.description: The single product to summarize for a category slot. Owned exclusively by the backend; the frontend must not mutate this directly.

categoryLabel.description: Display label of the product category this summary represents (e.g. 'Surfboard').

product.description: The single product to summarize, or null when no product is available for this slot.
